summary: Stone Point Credit Income Fund, a Delaware non-diversified closed-end management investment company, filed an 8-K to announce a regular monthly cash distribution of $0.21 per common share for August 2026, with record date August 31, 2026, and payment date September 20, 2026. The distribution may be reinvested under the Fund's distribution reinvestment plan. This routine dividend declaration does not represent a special situation; it is an ordinary operational event with no strategic implications for shareholders.
